School of Music

[1] Mission

The School of Music prepares performers, composers, and teachers. Its faculty are active as soloists and as scholars, and its ensembles perform across the region each season. Students audition for admission to the school after being admitted to the university.

[2] Bachelor of Arts

Course Requirements: 58 total credit hours from the categories below, of which 30 must be taken in residence at the university.

MUSC 1100Music Theory I3
MUSC 1200Aural Skills I3
MUSC 2100Music History I3

[3] Bachelor of Music Education Large Ensemble Requirements

Candidates perform in a large ensemble every semester in residence.

[4] Master of Music

The graduate degree is offered with concentrations in performance, conducting, and music education.
